methods.boundary_distance: Arc-length-weighted directed point-to-closed-polyline distances on saved raw/converted vertices and4096 exact target vertices. Symmetric mean averages directed means; symmetric RMS averages directed mean squares before square root; Hausdorff=max directed sampled maxima. This is a sampled-polyline comparison, not an exact supremum over smooth curves.
methods.target: r=0.05+0.0125*cos(5theta), center(0.5,0.5), validated against1024 archived target vertices to1e-14m.
methods.radial_phase: Saved polygon-area-centroid-based radial FFT uses theta_j=-pi+2pi*j/N. Physical cos(m theta),sin(m theta) coefficients are2*(-1)^m*real(c_m), -2*(-1)^m*imag(c_m). m5 error is Euclidean coefficient difference from(0.0125m,0). Its radial RMS contribution is coefficient error/sqrt(2). Own polygon area centroid (shoelace formula), shape-only metric; center error scored separately.
methods.signed_normal_score: Saved nearest-target normal projection dot actual fixed-normal motion, arc-weighted. Positive means local descent of half squared distance at unique nearest points; through-mode20 projection is not the finite total distance change. Normal/arclength m5 is not the polar radial m5.
methods.matched_work: Full comparison:5 updates each,33 versus35 attempted candidates. Strict common work:21 attempted candidates gives3 accepted steps in both. At cap33, compare E0 step5 against E1 step4 (last accepted by that cap).

assessment.multistatic_promotion_supported: Yes as the candidate principal factor: better signed normal correction, symmetric shape error, phase-aware m5 error, wrong-mode control, and shared evaluation at matched short work. This is early5-update evidence, not recovered-star or convergence evidence.
not_uniformly_better: Paired final one-sided curve-to-target maximum is slightly lower (raw36.798mm vs37.132mm); multistatic symmetric Hausdorff is lower (37.132mm vs37.589mm).
Target-to-curve directed mean favors paired (14.381mm vs14.907mm), although the directed RMS and symmetric RMS favor multistatic.
Both m5 amplitudes decrease; E1 improves m5 phase/coefficient error, not m5 amplitude recovery.
Field spread grows in both arms, and E1 minimum G worsens more.
E1 rejects some large proposals on topology/conversion, although accepted curves stay accurate.
assessment.optimizer_gate: No justification to remove Adam from these samples: at common20um RMS its actual nearest-target distance score exceeds total steepest descent for every sampled state in both arms. Paired total gradient becomes slightly geometrically adverse at state4 while Adam stays positive.
assessment.next_branch: Original-band multistatic is making admissible geometric progress and is the simpler candidate; these5 steps alone do not establish a need for high-band acquisition or neural GN/TSVD. Any longer experiment must keep the selected acquisition factor isolated and review field/geometry drift.
assessment.controlling_plan: 04_final_plan.md stage7(success criterion): promote actual neural geometric improvement at matched work, not training loss alone. Section18B selects multistatic if field-conditioning ambiguity is controlled and trajectory clearly improves; section19 retains star-only, fixed saved start, validated physics/fidelity/rollback, shared evaluation,60 accepted-update cap unless separately justified. The present early field spread remains modest and similar, but later drift must be monitored.
